Name: Farm Computers Check Cellars
Author: ianr427
Description:
[size=5]Install[/size][list=1]
[*][url=https://smapi.io]Install the latest version of SMAPI[/url].
[*]Download this mod and unzip it into [font=Courier New]Stardew Valley/Mods[/font].
[*]Run the game using SMAPI.
[/list]
[size=5]How to use[/size]
I tried to make this mod as vanilla as possible, so there isn't much you have to do here! Whenever a Farm Computer is interacted with, it will show its vanilla dialogue box. Once dismissed, a new dialogue box will appear with the Cellar information.

This is my first time programming in C#, so it isn't anything spectacular.

⚠️ This mod is considered 'abandoned' and will not be receiving a 1.6 update! Anyone is welcome to create a fork of this mod for use with the 1.6 update with my permission! You can contact me via my [url=https://discord.gg/eTCvTJ6Fv6]Discord server[/url].

[size=5]Compatibility[/size]
[list]
[*]Works with Stardew Valley 1.5 on Windows. I have not tested this mod on other platforms, but I don't see why it shouldn't work.
[*]Works in single player. I don't have available friends to test it on multiplayer, but again, I don't see why it shouldn't work.
[*]Works and is intended for use with the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5253]Upgrade Empty Cabins[/url] mod by [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/3590100]CherryChain[/url], but it is not required.
[*]Works with the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/19124]Farm Computer Plus[/url] mod by [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/43369427]boebie[/url].
[/list]
